summary.name: Photocopy Art / Zine Design (supplemental reference, Printmaking and Craft Materials)
summary.visualIdentity: Raw photocopied zine collage: high-contrast photos, visible grain, cutout headlines, tape or staples, irregular page layouts, and one information center. Supplemental reference, not a named source style.
summary.suitableUses: Suggested for activist explainers, DIY guides, community announcements, band promos, lyric zines and event recaps. Raw collages and cut-paste explainers are inferred fits; other briefs are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Monochrome with at most one accent, so it is a poor fit for full-color or polished brand work. Avoid handwriting body text, a third ink, annotations over faces, full-frame flashing and pasting everything at once. Keep lettering readable.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent: #FFFFFF, #000000 and #BF3232 are illustrative suggestions, not approved colors. Exact task or approved colors override them. Choose the ground from the scene; keep one optional accent and no gradients. Black on white is 21:1; white on #BF3232 is 5.649:1.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Animate page changes, pasting and recomposition with readable holds. Optional references motion-037, -038, -040 and -044 (-044 for heavy display type) only when scene copy supports them. Scroll patterns 007, 008, 012 and 015 need time-driven adaptation for video.
summary.audio: No audio was supplied or analysed. Music can follow paste rhythm only from verified beat timing. Voiceover, ambience or silence should follow the brief. Keep speech intelligible and protect reading holds.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are supplied. When used, prepare high-contrast photos, cut headline glyphs, fixed seeded grain, tape or staple shapes and local fonts with Pillow or Sharp. Do not invent copy or brand marks.
summary.combinations: Style-024 adds black or red marker pointers with one focal point, never for body text. Style-105 adds beat-locked paste timing from a verified beat table with fixed grain. Use the style alone for raw page collages.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default for composition, validation and export; Remotion is only a recorded fallback. Pillow and chroma-js preprocess assets and check colors. Renderer and motion engine are unspecified; GSAP provides the seekable timeline.
